Blue-footed Booby.

The blue-footed booby (Sula nebouxii) is a marine bird native to subtropical and tropical regions of the eastern Pacific Ocean.

Its most notable characteristic is its blue-colored feet, which can range in color from a pale turquoise to a deep aquamarine.

📸: @dstogs_photography

item.title: Hundreds of thousands of dollars in public subsidies goes to…
item.author: ProPublica (@propublica.org)
item.description:
Hundreds of thousands of dollars in public subsidies goes to funding internet service to unlivable buildings on Alaska’s Adak Island.

We knocked on every door and talked to every person we could find. Not a single one told us they used the service.
